    Lemma 6.4 for a split semisimple S = Λ₀ #

    lem:split-positive-deformation (positive-deformations.tex): "Let k be any field, let Λ be a finite-dimensional nonnegatively graded algebra with split semisimple S = Λ₀, and let B be a positive filtered deformation of Λ. Then S lifts to a unital subalgebra of B, and the filtration of B splits as S-bimodules. […] each μ_q raises internal degree by q, is S-relative, and vanishes when an input belongs to S."

    A split semisimple S ≅ ∏_a M_{n_a}(k) is recorded by a complete system of matrix units spanning Λ₀ (MatUnits: E_{ij} for i, j in one block, the block of i named by a root rt i). The diagonal units lift to orthogonal idempotents f_i (through the nilpotent ideal F¹), the units E_{i,rt i}, E_{rt i,i} lift to x_i, y_i with x_i y_i = f_i after inverting x_i y_i in the corner f_iBf_i (geometric series), and then y_i x_i = f_{rt i} (an idempotent congruent to f_{rt i} modulo F¹); L_{ij} = x_i y_j are lifted matrix units (L_mul, σ_L). The splitting of the corners (φ0, from the diagonal idempotents) is transported from the root corners: Φ(a) = Σ_{i,j} L_{i,rt i} φ0(E_{rt i,i} a E_{j,rt j}) L_{rt j,j}, which is S-bilinear (Φ_left, Φ_right), unital and has leading term the identity (Φ_lead). The statement is splitPositiveDeformation_ss.

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.LenGrading.MatUnits {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {Λ : Type u_2} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] (G : LenGrading k Λ) :
    Type u_2

    A split semisimple degree-zero part Λ₀ ≅ ∏_a M_{n_a}(k): a complete system of matrix units of degree 0 spanning Λ₀. Indices in one block have the same root rt i; E_{ij} is defined for i, j in one block and zero otherwise.

    • n : ℕ
    • rt : Fin self.n → Fin self.n
    • rt_rt (i : Fin self.n) : self.rt (self.rt i) = self.rt i
    • E : Fin self.n → Fin self.n → Λ
    • E_mul (i j l m : Fin self.n) : self.rt i = self.rt j → self.rt l = self.rt m → self.E i j * self.E l m = if j = l then self.E i m else 0
    • E_off (i j : Fin self.n) : self.rt i ≠ self.rt j → self.E i j = 0
    • sum_E : ∑ i : Fin self.n, self.E i i = 1
    • deg0 (i j : Fin self.n) : G.IsHom 0 (self.E i j)
    • span0 (a : Λ) : G.IsHom 0 a → ∃ (c : Fin self.n → Fin self.n → k), a = ∑ i : Fin self.n, ∑ j : Fin self.n, c i j • self.E i j

                              Lemma 6.4 (lem:split-positive-deformation) for a split semisimple S = Λ₀ (given by matrix units MatUnits): there is a splitting φ : Λ ≅ B (a filtered linear isomorphism, φ 1 = 1, inducing the identification gr B = Λ) which is multiplicative on S (so S lifts to the unital subalgebra φ(S)) and S-bilinear on both sides; the transported multiplication is μ₀ + Σ_{q>0} μ_q with μ₀ the multiplication of Λ, each μ_q raising the degree by q, S-relative and vanishing when an input belongs to S.

                              A splitting exists for a split semisimple Λ₀, so Proposition 6.5 (exists_fLift_of_split, fLift_unique_of_split, fLift_map_of_split, fLift_leading_of_split, fLift_gr_hom_of_split, fLift_orderGe_zero_of_split, isRad_iff, mem_radPow_iff) applies; the splitting is multiplicative on the left by every e ∈ Λ₀, so Split.regularLift gives the regular lifts eB of eΛ for every idempotent e of Λ₀.
